user.title: Connect to the Scalable bridge
user.description: Search for the Scalable CLI Bridge add-on on the internal network and connect. Make sure the add-on is installed and started, and that you have logged in from its panel. Leave the URL empty to auto-detect (expected: {default_url}); fill it in only if auto-detection fails.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on. Make sure the Scalable CLI Bridge add-on is installed and started.

abort.already_configured: The Scalable bridge is already configured.

init.title: Scalable Capital options
init.description: Advanced: override the bridge URL (leave unchanged for the standard add-on) and set the polling interval (min {min_interval} s). The add-on option 'scan_interval' overrides this value when set.
